title: Evaluation of a block minterm
statement: Let $m\geq 7$, let $b<m$, let $a$ assign a sign to each of the $2m$ positions, and let $x$ be a sign vector with $2^m$ coordinates. The block minterm determined by $m,b,a$ evaluates to $-1$ on $x$ if and only if $a$ agrees at every position with the restriction of $x$ to the block coordinates indexed by $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector on $2^m$ coordinates
